error[ZBX-E0551]: the destination cannot be pushed to
  cause  'registry.test/app' cannot be pushed to: it names no tag
  dest   registry.test/app
  fix    name a registry, a repository and a tag: registry.example/team/app:1.0
  more   zbx explain E0551
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0551.html
